title: Cloud metadata & SSRF validation (authorized)
description: Test for SSRF reachability to metadata endpoints safely.
detail: Authorized targets only. 1) If SSRF suspected, test with benign callbacks you control (approved OOB) rather than exfiltrating secrets. 2) Metadata IPs: 169.254.169.254 (AWS/Azure/GCP classic patterns vary; IMDSv2 requires token). 3) Confirm impact minimally (reachability) and report; do not harvest credentials from production metadata unless explicitly authorized. Use ssrf-metadata/cloud-attack skills.
